description: TOTP / HOTP two-factor codes (RFC 6238 / 4226), compatible with Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password and pyotp: generate the current code (plus previous / next and seconds remaining), verify a code with a drift window, create a new base32 secret with its otpauth:// URI for QR enrolment, or parse an otpauth URI. SHA1 / SHA256 / SHA512, 6–8 digits, any period; set time for reproducible results or counter for HOTP. POST so secrets never appear in URLs; secrets are not stored. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/totp

account.description: Account label for the otpauth URI, e.g. alice@example.com
